description: List spaced repetition review dates for a topic at expanding intervals, so you revisit it just before you would forget it. Dates on or after the exam are marked to skip. Dates can be plain text, like Dec 12 or in 3 weeks. Example prompt: "When should I review what I learned today for my exam on 2026-11-30?"

exam_date.description: Exam date, if any. Reviews on or after it are skipped. Use 2026-12-12, or plain text like Dec 12, next Friday or in 3 weeks.

first_study_date.description: The day you first studied it. Defaults to today. Use 2026-12-12, or plain text like Dec 12, next Friday or in 3 weeks.

intervals_days.description: Days after the first study to review.

name: spaced_repetition_dates
title: Spaced repetition dates
